facts.fact: Ben 一眼识破 Oliver 的走神来源，火速转告 Michelle，两人组成劝追参谋部。
facts.anchor: It’s the girl, isn’t it! Oh my god, Michelle is going to love this!

facts.fact: Oliver 对 Eden 的判读：她只是不想挂科，赌注太大，谁都别想挡路——包括他自己。
facts.anchor: She just wants to not fail. She’s got a lot riding on this, and I don’t think anything will get in her way. Let alone me.

facts.fact: 第二次辅导气氛转好，Eden 主动提议一起去校边拉面店吃饭。
facts.anchor: We pack up in amicable silence, so I don’t know why I’m so surprised when she suggests we go eat together at this ramen place near campus.

facts.fact: 被问「然后呢」时 Oliver 脱口说出：我想写书，而且已经在写。
facts.anchor: I want to write a book. I am writing a book.

facts.fact: 妈妈是 photojournalist、写了一辈子日记；Oliver 想用她的照片与日记做成一本书。
facts.anchor: She was a photojournalist. I want to create a book with all her photos. She’s kept a diary all her life, so I wanted to use that too.

facts.fact: 拉面桌上互相交底：Eden 是五个孩子的老大、家里第一个大学生。
facts.anchor: I learn that she’s the oldest of five and the first one to go to university.

facts.fact: Oliver 走神把「你闻起来像香草杯子蛋糕」说出声，被 Eden 本人听到抓包。
facts.anchor: You said I smell like a vanilla cupcake.

facts.fact: 章末 Eden 回应「想不想改变这一点」——她说你让我好奇，Oliver 顺势同句回敬。
facts.anchor: I think I do. You intrigue me, Oliver James.
